facts.fact: A Sudanese lawyer, Majida Idris, tells the BBC that the conflict in Darfur has shut down civil registry offices and left thousands of children unregistered, without birth certificate or national number; no office count is given and the document gives no date for the closures, so its publication date is used.

systems.tiers: local civil registry offices, where a child is registered after referral from social services; those in Darfur reported shut down; nothing said of any digital system

systems.owner: hospital (one named is run by the International Medical Corps)
systems.tiers: issued by the hospital where the child is born, ahead of registration; no digital tool described
